question: 'The Constitution of free India must be framed, without outside interference by a constituent assembly elected on the basis of adult franchise'. Who made this statement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru:-**

 
 
• He made the statement that the Constitution of free India must be framed without outside interference by a constituent assembly elected on the basis of adult franchise.
 
• This statement was made in the context of India's struggle for independence from Britis
